WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event,
         e.location,
         AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_over_budget
  FROM budget AS b
  JOIN event AS e
    ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.location
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT link_to_event,
         location,
         avg_over_budget,
         RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY location
           ORDER BY avg_over_budget DESC
         ) AS rank_in_location
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT link_to_event, location, avg_over_budget, rank_in_location
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_in_location <= 3
